name: Kutná Hora: Historical Town Centre with the Church of St Barbara and the Cathedral of Our Lady at Sedlec
description: Kutná Hora, a town in central Bohemia east of Prague, grew rich on silver mining and became a royal city in the 14th century. Its skyline is crowned by the Church of St Barbara, a late Gothic landmark, and the Baroque-restored Cathedral of Our Lady at Sedlec. Both stand among well-preserved medieval streets lined with fine townhouses.
